info.title: Naoero Airlines website content API
info.description:
The content API of the Naoero Airlines website and app: pages, banners, team, destinations, specials, schedules, legal text, news and forms. Everything here is edited in the admin panel (https://api.napacificbridge.info/admin) and read by the website and the app, so a change made there shows on both within seconds.

**No sign-in is needed to read.** Replies are JSON, usually `{"success": true, "data": …}`; errors are `{"success": false, "message": …}`; form errors are `422` with `errors`.

### How pages stay live
1. Fetch `GET /api/pages/{slug}` and show it. Keep the `ETag`.
2. While the page is open, ask `GET /api/content/versions` every 20-30 seconds (or `GET /api/pages/{slug}` with `If-None-Match`). A `304` costs almost nothing.
3. When a version changed, fetch that page again and update the screen. Keep the page's built-in text as a fallback for a hidden page (`404`) or no connection.

Pages are built as a static site in the website project, so read the API in the browser (client-side), as the dynamic pages already do, instead of at build time.

The booking and account API for the app is documented separately at `/api/v1/docs`.

get.description:
The page as the admin panel has it: title, search-engine text, the top banner and an ordered list of sections. Render each section by its `key` with your own design, or by its `type` for a section you do not know.

**Live updates.** Every reply carries an `ETag`; ask again with `If-None-Match` and you get an empty `304` while nothing changed, so asking often is cheap. Do not cache the reply for longer than it takes to ask again (`Cache-Control: no-cache`). `GET /content/versions` tells you what changed across all pages in one small call.

**Channels.** Some sections belong to one design only: `?channel=website` leaves out app-only sections, `?channel=app` leaves out website-only sections.

**Text.** `body_html`, `note_html` and `text_html` carry the text ready to show (escaped; paragraphs, lists, bold and links). `body`, `note` and `text` are the plain text with the same marks, for apps that draw their own text.

A page that is hidden or does not exist answers `404`: show the page's built-in text instead.

get.description:
One small reply with the version of every page and of every other admin-managed list (team, specials, FAQs, banners …). Ask it every 20-30 seconds while a page is open and fetch again only what changed. This is how an edit in the admin panel reaches the website and the app within seconds.

`collections.<name>.paths` lists the endpoints that serve that content, so a changed version tells you which calls to repeat.
